props.text: Six Hundred Products, Sixteen Categories, and the Project That Doesn't Fit Any of Them

The AI agent market now has 616 cataloged products across 16 categories — infrastructure frameworks, vertical execution agents, crypto-native agents. A new ecosystem map shows where the borders are. This article explores what falls through the grid: projects that combine simulation engines, autonomous maintenance agents, and on-chain tokens in a shape nobody drew a category for. MiroShark sits in that interstitial space, and what it reveals is that the most interesting work may be happening at the seams the taxonomies left out.
